description: Add a persistent spec knowledge base to the pipeline: a local vector index (sentence-transformers) for semantic Q&A plus Memento graph integration (Neo4j via MCP) to store spec learnings as structured nodes. Inserts a 'save-knowledge' step between IR mapping and code generation, and exposes a spec-ask CLI entry point.

steps.title: Create src/knowledge/ module — SpecKnowledgeIndex (vector index)
steps.description: Create stacks/spec-to-test/src/knowledge/__init__.py and src/knowledge/indexer.py. Implement SpecKnowledgeIndex: embed SectionChunks with sentence-transformers (all-MiniLM-L6-v2), persist to knowledge_dir as chunks.json + embeddings.npy + meta.json. Include incremental build (skip already-indexed chunks via SHA-256 hash). Expose search(query, top_k) returning (chunk, score) tuples sorted by cosine similarity. The Write tool has been intermittently failing — write one file at a time and verify each with Read before moving on.

output.summary: Create src/knowledge/ module — SpecKnowledgeIndex (vector index) — completed

steps.title: Create src/knowledge/qa_engine.py — SpecQAEngine (semantic retrieval + Claude answer)
steps.description: Implement SpecQAEngine(knowledge_dir, claude_model). Method ask(question) -> AnswerResult: (1) load index if not loaded, (2) search top-5 chunks, (3) build context block from chunk markdown, (4) call Claude claude-sonnet-4-6 with prompt-cached system prompt asking it to answer ONLY from provided context, (5) return AnswerResult(answer, sources, confidence). Use prompt caching on system prompt (cache_control: ephemeral). Return NO_ANSWER sentinel when no chunk scores above 0.40. Make model configurable, default claude-sonnet-4-6.

output.summary: Create src/knowledge/qa_engine.py — SpecQAEngine (semantic retrieval + Claude answer) — completed

steps.title: Create src/knowledge/memento_bridge.py — persist spec learnings to Memento graph
steps.description: Implement MementoBridge(stack). Method index_chunks(chunks, plan_id) iterates over SectionChunks and calls memento-knowledge.add_learning() for each testcase/reusable_state chunk, storing: title, section_type, page range, and a 1-sentence summary derived from the first 200 chars of markdown. Use add_learning not add_decision (these are facts extracted from the spec, not architectural choices). Rate-limit to 5 concurrent Neo4j writes via asyncio.Semaphore. Skip chunks already indexed (query search_knowledge_graph for title before writing). Only import the memento MCP client if the memento server is reachable; fail gracefully with a warning if not.

output.summary: Create src/knowledge/memento_bridge.py — persist spec learnings to Memento graph — completed

steps.title: Wire knowledge step into pipeline (ir/mapper.py) and CLI (cli.py + pyproject.toml)
steps.description: Four sub-tasks: (1) Add save_knowledge(chunks, knowledge_dir) helper in ir/mapper.py that calls SpecKnowledgeIndex.build() + MementoBridge.index_chunks() after map()/map_async() completes — this inserts the knowledge step between IR extraction and code gen. (2) Add --save-knowledge DIR option to cli.py main command. (3) Add spec-ask console script to pyproject.toml pointing at a new spec_to_test.knowledge.qa_engine:ask_cli Click command. (4) Implement ask_cli() Click command in qa_engine.py: takes QUESTION arg + --knowledge DIR + --top-k INT + --model STR, prints answer + source chunk IDs.

output.summary: Wire knowledge step into pipeline (ir/mapper.py) and CLI (cli.py + pyproject.toml) — completed

steps.title: Write tests for the knowledge module
steps.description: Create stacks/spec-to-test/tests/test_knowledge.py with 10+ tests: (1) SpecKnowledgeIndex.build() from synthetic chunks, assert chunks.json + embeddings.npy written; (2) incremental build skips unchanged chunks (mock embed, verify call count); (3) search() returns top-k sorted by score; (4) load() restores state; (5) load() raises FileNotFoundError on missing index; (6) SpecQAEngine.ask() with mocked Anthropic client returns AnswerResult; (7) ask() returns NO_ANSWER when all scores < 0.40; (8) MementoBridge.index_chunks() calls add_learning for each chunk; (9) MementoBridge skips chunks already in graph. Use pytest tmp_path for all file I/O, mock sentence_transformers.SentenceTransformer to avoid downloading the model.

output.summary: Write tests for the knowledge module — completed
